2801:Every `--compose-*` flag behaves exactly as it does for `eval run` — see
2968:Omit `--session` to start a conversation; pass the `sessionId` the command returns to continue one. A session created by `clo
ud sessions browser open` is initially unconfigured and accepts its model configuration with its first send. After the first model
turn, the session is configured: `--model`, `--environment`, `--server`, `--no-servers`, `--system-prompt` and `--tool-mode` are
then refused alongside `--session` rather than silently repinning it.
2975:| `--model <modelId>` | Provider-prefixed model id, e.g. `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5`. Optional on the first send: defaults to
the selected environment’s or client’s model and is then pinned. A supplied ID must be provider-prefixed. |
